name: Chicken & Beef Combo
description: Crispy fried chicken and beef stir-fried with peppers and onion, served with yellow rice, pea and carrot stew and a fresh kachumbari salad.

name: Beef Stew & Crumbed Fish
description: Slow-cooked beef stew and a golden crumbed fish fillet with rosemary potatoes, broccoli, cauliflower and carrot, plus pea stew and kachumbari.

name: Goat Stew & Pilau
description: Tender bone-in goat stewed with tomato and spices, fragrant pilau rice with a fried chicken wing, pea and carrot stew and kachumbari.

name: Braised Beef & Roast Vegetables
description: Beef braised in a rich tomato gravy with pilau rice, roasted peppers and aubergine, broccoli and carrot, and kachumbari.

name: Fresh Mango Juice
description: Made from Malawian mangoes, no added sugar, 350ml.
